title: Abr1 Cheat Panel
features:
Features

UI
- Draggable UI
- Animated opening and closing
- Opens/Closes with the K key
- Scrollable menu
- Dark themed interface

Movement
- WalkSpeed Slider (16–200)
- JumpPower Slider (50–500)
- Fly
- Fly Speed Slider (10–300)
- Noclip
- Freecam

Player Features
- ESP (Highlights all other players)
- Teleport to Player (Username textbox)

Health
- God Mode (Currently marked as not working)

Controls
- K = Open/Close Menu
- W A S D = Fly/Freecam movement
- Space = Move Freecam Up
- Left Shift = Move Freecam Down

Other
- Respawn support
- Restores collisions after respawning
- Automatically updates character references after death
